patch.summary:
Choose Flippa only if your buying job matches “Online business and website marketplace — affiliate partner in website & digital presence.” rather than Spocket's shape. Choose Spocket only if your buying job matches “US/EU dropshipping sourcing app — Starter $39.99/mo, Pro $59.99/mo, Empire $99.99/mo, Unic” rather than Flippa's shape. Workflow advantage: Flippa leans digital-business-marketplace, online-storefront; Spocket leans dropshipping-sourcing. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Flippa is Online business and website marketplace — affiliate partner in website & digital presence.; Spocket is US/EU dropshipping sourcing app — Starter $39.99/mo, Pro $59.99/mo, Empire $99.99/mo, Unicorn $299.99/mo; 7-day trial; product caps per tier.
- Workflow coverage skew: Flippa-leaning digital-business-marketplace, online-storefront vs Spocket-leaning dropshipping-sourcing.
- Researched limits: Flippa — Marketplace for buying/selling businesses — not a storefront or cart; Spocket — Not a storefront — requires Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, BigCommerce, or similar.

Limitations — Flippa: Marketplace for buying/selling businesses — not a storefront or cart; Seller success fees scale with exit price — model before listing; Spocket: Not a storefront — requires Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, BigCommerce, or similar; Product caps force tier upgrades as catalog grows.
